question: What marks should be written on the intermediate petals and before the cells?
premises: Writing is done on the intermediate petals.
Trident marks are to be drawn.
These marks are placed in front of the cells.
inference: Having written on the intermediate petals, one should write trident marks in front of the cells.
plain_english: Having written on the intermediate petals, one should write trident marks in front of the cells.
